name: 作物收获手测夹具（DTMAPI）
author: DTMAPI QA
description: 开发者手测夹具。依赖 DTMAPI，仅调用 ICropHarvestingApi 测试作物容器扫描/收获；乔木盆、草/采集类只用于 unsupported 边界确认，不发布到 Workshop。

localized_description.schinese: 开发者手测夹具。通过 DTMAPI CropHarvesting API 扫描普通、藤蔓、菌包、灌木等作物容器；乔木盆、草/采集类仅用于确认 unsupported，不执行收获。
localized_description.tchinese: 開發者手測夾具。透過 DTMAPI CropHarvesting API 掃描普通、藤蔓、菌包、灌木等作物容器；喬木盆與草/採集類僅用於確認 unsupported，不執行收穫。
localized_description.english: Developer-only manual QA fixture. Scans ordinary, vine, mushroom-bag, and bush crop containers through ICropHarvestingApi; tree-basin and grass/forage targets are unsupported-boundary checks and are not harvested.
